citation_note: Matsumura et al., EMBO Journal 1999; STAT5-dependent cyclin D1 promoter and hematopoietic growth evidence.
evidence_summary: Dominant-negative STAT5 reduces IL-3-dependent growth and cyclin D1 mRNA; STAT5A transactivates the cyclin D1 promoter through a -481 bp STAT element; EMSA shows STAT5 binding; cyclin D1 rescues the growth defect.

citation_note: Matsumoto et al., Blood 1997; direct CISH/CIS promoter and STAT5 feedback evidence.

limitations: Promoter/reconstitution evidence is strongest for EPO/STAT5 and induction also includes IL-2/IL-3. The paper does not establish IL-5, IL-7, IL-9, IL-15, or SCI receiver-cell receptor-specific induction.
consolidation_note: Validated from the primary PubMed record after external retrieval; direct STAT5-to-CISH target edge retained with cytokine and comparator-cell boundaries.
